messages:
maria_sales: Customer (FinMetrics) sent MSA + DPA redlines, procurement pressing for signed order form + PO by EOD Thursday. They flagged SLA latency SLO and data residency clause.
sarah_legal: Thanks — looking now. Quick note: they removed our standard subprocessor language and added an EU-only data residency requirement. I can accept EU residency for logs+metrics but not model weights without exec signoff.
alex_account_exec: @sarah_legal can we do EU logs only? customer says they need "data stored in eu-west-1" — also asking about `SLA: 99.9%` vs our 99.5 default. Pricing team ok to adjust for committed Dedicated.
jon_ml: Technical check: to meet EU residency for inference we need Dedicated in eu-west-1; Private on-prem would work but longer lead time. Can support with Reserved capacity + pin model version.
rachel_finance: For PO flow — finance needs purchase order address + VAT info. Also confirm billing cadence (monthly vs annual). If they want 99.9 SLA we need a bump on monthly commit.
sarah_legal: Suggested redlines: keep our subprocessor clause, add EU data residency for logs only, add "Customer may request model weights residency subject to platform & legal review". Also: change indemnity cap from 1x to 2x? No, we should keep 1x.
maria_sales: Customer also attached an order form with line items. snippet:
```
- Redwood Inference Dedicated - 4xA100 (eu-west-1)
- Monthly commit: $45,000
- SLA: 99.5% (requested 99.9%)
- Term: 12 months
```
They want signature routing through DocuSign to their procurement mailbox procurement@finmetrics.com.
alex_account_exec: Proposed next steps: (1) legal approve DPA redlines w/ EU logs-only fallback, (2) finance confirm VAT + billing cadence, (3) send updated order form with pricing tweak for 99.9 SLA + route to DocuSign.
sarah_legal: I can accept EU logs-only and keep the 1x cap. I want clause: "Fallback to 99.5% without SLA credits if customer requires model-weights residency."
rachel_finance: Confirmed VAT: GB/IE/EU handled via our tax entity. For PO: they need invoice to FinMetrics Ltd, VAT ID GB999999. Billing cadence: annual preferred — if they do annual we can do a 5% discount.
maria_sales: OK I'm going to update order form: set SLA to 99.9% but make it conditional: pricing + 5% uplift for 99.9. Add billing annual discount. Route to @contracts_bot to create DocuSign envelope to procurement@finmetrics.com and cc: legal@redwood.com.
contracts_bot: DocuSign envelope created: envelope id env_0x9a... Status: draft. Template: OrderForm_v3. Please review before sending.
alex_account_exec: I'll review doc, pinging @sarah_legal for final redline approval. ETA 2 hours.
sarah_legal: Reviewing now. If we agree, send with "signature by authorized signatory" clause and include countersign path.
maria_sales: Thanks team — tagging action items: @sarah_legal approve DPA redline (logs-only) | @rachel_finance confirm annual price with 5% discount | @alex_account_exec finalize order form & trigger DocuSign. Will update thread when sent. :thumbsup:
